Rashi on Nedarim 37a:1:1.hebrew: והא קא משמע לן - מתני' דאפי' במקום שנוטלין שכר וכו'. ולהכי לא ילמדנו מקרא, דהואיל ושרי למשקל שכר, אם מלמדו בחנם, מהני ליה מן השכר שהיה לו ליתן:
Rashi on Nedarim 37a:1:1.english: And this teaches us - The Mishnah [teaches] that even in a place where one takes payment, etc. And therefore he may not teach him Scripture, for since it is permitted to take payment [for it], if he teaches him for free, he benefits him by [saving him] the payment that he would have had to give.

Rashi on Nedarim 37a:3:1.hebrew: רב אמר - מאי טעמא התירו למשקל שכר מן המקרא? מפני שאין נוטלין שכר אלא על שכר שימור, שמשמרין התינוקות שאין מניחין אותן לצאת ולעסוק בדברים בטלים, ולא שכר לימוד המקרא. וקטנים דצריכין שימור למדין מקרא, ולא גדולים. ולהכי לא ילמדנו מקרא לקטנים בחנם, דהואיל ושרי למשקל עלייהו שכר, קמהני השכר שהיה לו ליתן. אבל מלמדו מדרש, דקטנים אין לומדים מדרש אלא לגדולים, וגדולים לית להו שכר שימור, ולא קמהני להו כלל, ולהכי שרי:
Rashi on Nedarim 37a:3:1.english: Rav said - What is the reason they permitted taking payment for [teaching] Scripture? Because one only takes payment as a fee for watching [the children] — that they watch the young children so that they do not let them go out and engage in idle matters — and not payment for teaching Scripture. And young children, who need watching, learn Scripture, whereas adults do not. Therefore, he may not teach [his] young children Scripture for free, for since it is permitted to take payment for them, he benefits him [by saving him] the payment that he would have had to give. However, he may teach him Midrash, for young children do not learn Midrash, rather [it is taught] only to adults; and adults do not have a fee for watching, and he does not benefit them at all, and therefore it is permitted.

Rashi on Nedarim 37a:3:2.hebrew: ורבי יוחנן אומר שכר פיסוק טעמים - שקיל מנייהו, שמלמדם ניקוד וטעמים, וההוא שכר מצי למשקל. ופיסוק טעמים אינו אלא במקרא, ולהכי לא ילמדנו מקרא:
Rashi on Nedarim 37a:3:2.english: And Rabbi Yoḥanan said: Payment for punctuation of cantillation notes - He takes [payment] from them because he teaches them vocalization and cantillation notes, and he may take that payment. And punctuation of cantillation notes is only in Scripture, and therefore he may not teach him Scripture.

Rashi on Nedarim 37a:4:1.hebrew: בקטן - (משום דקא מהני ליה שמניח לו את השכר) תריץ מתני' דקתני לא ילמדנו מקרא בקטן, משום דקא מהני ליה, שמניח לו את השכר שהיה לו ליתן:
Rashi on Nedarim 37a:4:1.english: About a minor - (Because he benefits him, in that he waives the fee for him) [The Gemara] explains the Mishnah, which teaches "he may not teach him Scripture," [as referring] to a minor, because he benefits him, in that he waives the fee for him that he would have had to pay.

Rashi on Nedarim 37a:5:1.hebrew: והכי קתני לא ילמדנו מקרא לקטן - בחנם, משום דקא מהני ליה שכר השימור. אבל אם היה גדול, מלמדו לו ולבניו מקרא. גדול — משום דאיהו לא צריך שימור ולא קמהני ליה, ולבניו נמי, הואיל ואביהן עמהם, הוא משמרם וליכא שכר שימור:
Rashi on Nedarim 37a:5:1.english: And this is what it teaches: He may not teach him Scripture, [referring] to a minor - [Even] for free, because he benefits him [with] the wage for watching [him]. However, if he was an adult, he may teach him and his sons Scripture. An adult [is permitted] because he does not need watching and he does not benefit him; and his sons as well [are permitted], since their father is with them, he watches them and there is no wage for watching.

Rashi on Nedarim 37a:6:1.hebrew: לא קורין בתחילה בשבת - אין מתחילין ללמדם בתחילה בשבת בדבר שלא למדו מעולם, אבל שונין בראשון — כלומר, בדבר שלמדוהו כבר פעם ראשונה, לומדים אותן פעם שניה בשבת. ולהכי קתני בראשון, דרבותא קמ"ל, אע"פ שלא למדוהו התינוקות אלא פעם אחת, שונין:
Rashi on Nedarim 37a:6:1.english: [Children] may not read for the first time on Shabbat - One does not begin to teach them initially on Shabbat something that they have never learned before, but they may review [what they learned] the first time — that is to say, something that they have already learned a first time, they [may] teach them a second time on Shabbat. And for this [reason] it teaches "the first time," for it teaches us a novelty: even though the children have learned it only one time, they may review [it].

Rashi on Nedarim 37a:6:2.english: Granted, according to the one who says [that] payment for [teaching] punctuation of cantillation notes - it is permitted to take [it].

Rashi on Nedarim 37a:6:3.hebrew: הייינו דאין קורן בתחילה בשבת - דהואיל ומעולם לא למדו דבר זה אלא עכשיו, אינו מלמדו אלא בשכר ואתי למשקל שכר בשבת. אבל שונין, דעביד ליה בלא שכר:
Rashi on Nedarim 37a:6:3.english: This is [the reason] that they do not read [a passage] for the first time on Shabbat - For since he has never taught him this matter until now, he only teaches him for payment, and he would come to take payment on Shabbat. However, they may review [it], since he does it without payment.

Rashi on Nedarim 37a:6:4.hebrew: אמאי שונין בראשון - אפילו שונין לא, דהא איכא שכר שימור דשבת, ואתי למשקל שכר בשבת:
Rashi on Nedarim 37a:6:4.english: Why may they review [what they learned] once - Even reviewing [should] not [be permitted], for there is payment for watching [the children] on Shabbat, and [the teacher] will come to take payment on Shabbat.

Rashi on Nedarim 37a:7:1.english: It is incorporation - As it teaches [in the baraita], and it is completely permitted.

Rashi on Nedarim 37a:7:2.english: As it is taught: One who hires a laborer - [meaning] that he gives him his wage for each day.

Rashi on Nedarim 37a:7:3.english: To watch the child - From ritual impurity.

Rashi on Nedarim 37a:7:4.english: To guard the seeds - For the need of the omer.

Tosafot on Nedarim 37a:1:1.hebrew: הא קמ"ל דאפילו במקום שנוטלין שכר על המקרא וכו' - מפרש ואזיל טעמא ד"מה אני בחנם", דכתיב "ראה למדתי אתכם", ומסתמא משה לא נטל שכר מישראל, שעשיר היה:
Tosafot on Nedarim 37a:1:1.english: This teaches us that even in a place where one takes payment for [teaching] Bible, etc. - [The Gemara] goes on to explain the reason: "just as I [taught] for free," as it is written, "Behold, I have taught you" [Deuteronomy 4:5] — and presumably Moses did not take payment from Israel, since he was wealthy.

Tosafot on Nedarim 37a:3:1.hebrew: שכר שימור - שמשמר מלמד תינוקות שלא ילכו אנה ואנה, אבל מדרש אינו צריך ללמוד כ"א לגדול שאינו צריך שימור, כבן עשר למשנה:
Tosafot on Nedarim 37a:3:1.english: Payment for watching - That a teacher of young children watches [them] so that they do not go here and there; whereas Midrash one only needs to teach to an older [child] who does not need watching, such as a ten-year-old [learning] Mishnah.

Tosafot on Nedarim 37a:3:2.hebrew: שכר פיסוק טעמים - וסבר דפיסוק אינו צריך אלא מדרבנן, ולא שייך לומר: "מה אני בחנם אף אתם בחנם":
Tosafot on Nedarim 37a:3:2.english: Payment for punctuation of cantillation notes - And [Rabbi Yoḥanan] holds that punctuation is only required by rabbinic law, and [therefore] it is not applicable to say, "Just as I [taught] for free, so too you [must teach] for free."

Tosafot on Nedarim 37a:4:1.english: "Is an adult one who requires watching?" - It seems to him [the questioner] that the Mishnah deals even with adults.

Tosafot on Nedarim 37a:5:1.hebrew: חסורי מיחסרא והכי קתני - וה"פ: לא ילמדנו מקרא — ברגיל ללמוד מקרא, דהיינו קטן; אבל מלמד הוא בניו מקרא, אם ראוי לבנים:
Tosafot on Nedarim 37a:5:1.english: "The Mishnah is incomplete, and this is what it is teaching" - And this is its explanation: "He may not teach him Scripture" — [referring to] one who is accustomed to study Scripture, that is, a minor; "however, he may teach his sons Scripture," if he is capable of [having] sons.

Tosafot on Nedarim 37a:6:1.english: They do not read for the first time on Shabbat - Because of the delight of Shabbat.

Tosafot on Nedarim 37a:6:2.hebrew: אבל שונין בראשון - פירוש: יכולין לחזור חזרה ראשונה בשבת:
Tosafot on Nedarim 37a:6:2.english: "However, they may review [what they learned] the first time" - Explanation: They may do a first review on Shabbat.

Tosafot on Nedarim 37a:6:3.hebrew: היינו דאין קורין בתחילה - מפני שמשתכר בשבת ומחזי כמקח וממכר, אבל שונין בראשון — דכיון דלימדו זו מערב שבת, יודעין אותו מערב שבת:
Tosafot on Nedarim 37a:6:3.english: This is [the reason] that they may not read [a passage] for the first time - Because he earns a wage on Shabbat, and it appears like buying and selling; however, they may review [a passage already learned] once, for since he taught [them] this on Shabbat eve, they [already] know it from Shabbat eve.

Tosafot on Nedarim 37a:6:4.english: And if [it is] because of payment for watching, why [may] they review at first - Isn't there payment for watching?

Tosafot on Nedarim 37a:7:1.hebrew: הבלעה היא - ששכר שבת נבלע, ולא מיחזי כמקח וממכר, שפוסק לו כך לחצי שנה:
Tosafot on Nedarim 37a:7:1.english: It is [a case of] incorporation - For the wage for Shabbat is absorbed [into the overall wage], and it does not appear like buying and selling, since he stipulates [to pay] him such-and-such [an amount] for half a year.

Tosafot on Nedarim 37a:7:2.english: "To watch the child" - [That is, guarding him from ritual impurity] for the purpose of the purification waters.

Tosafot on Nedarim 37a:7:3.hebrew: לשמור הזרעים - לצורך עומר ושתי הלחם בשביעית. אם שוכר ליומי, אין נותנין לו שכר, דמיחזי כמקח וממכר אם היה נוטל:
Tosafot on Nedarim 37a:7:3.english: To guard the seeds - [That is,] for the need of the omer and the Two Loaves in the Sabbatical year. If one hires [him] by the day, one does not give him wages [for Shabbat], for it appears like buying and selling if he were to take [them].
